_why: Echoes readers already know, added where the stage-1 readers did not propose them (Doug, 2026-10-04: 'if you happen to find known ones that we don't represent yet as story echos, don't avoid them'). Listed from Claude's own knowledge of the text; each still goes to the strict stage-2 judge with no free pass. later = the story that tells the other again.
